value.name: writes correction draft
value.description: Asha sits down and drafts a formal correction explaining the filing error and the proper attorney of record.
evidence: She pulled a legal pad from the briefcase and uncapped a pen, and began writing out the correction in the spare, formal phrasing she would need on the page itself: the line identifying the original signatory, the line substituting the correct attorney of record, the short note explaining that the Tuesday filing had been executed by a junior associate under her supervision while she was out of state.

value.name: rewrites Devin's name carefully
value.description: She rewrites the correction a second time, deliberately placing Devin's name where it belongs without crossing it out.
evidence: She wrote it twice, the second time slower, watching her own hand form Devin's name in the block where it would actually belong, and she did not cross it out.

value.name: composes firm text message
value.description: Asha opens the message thread and sends Devin a direct text saying she is coming over and they need to talk.
evidence: Asha turned the phone over and woke the screen.
The thread was still open to the photo of the filing, Devin's name in the block where hers should have been, and she scrolled past it without rereading and typed into the empty field at the bottom.
I am coming to your place. We need to talk.

Then she set the phone screen-up beside the legal pad, where the corrected paragraph with his name in the signature block lay under the cap of her pen, and she waited the few seconds it took for the small gray tick to confirm the message had gone.

value.name: waits for message confirmation
value.description: After sending the text, Asha waits until the message is confirmed delivered.
evidence: she waited the few seconds it took for the small gray tick to confirm the message had gone.

value.name: tears off second draft
value.description: Asha tears the second draft off the legal pad, ending the drafting phase.
